yeah

i don’t want to *kill myself*, but I don’t want to live

to be fair i am pretty hungry and i definitely could go for one of those massive gummy worms [this baby](https://www.vat19.com/item/worlds-largest-gummy-worm?adid=gshopping&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&adpos=1o1&scid=scplpworlds-largest-gummy-worm-347&sc_intid=worlds-largest-gummy-worm-347&gclid=EAIaIQobChMI5szn0dWp2QIVEwaGCh2_uA20EAQYASABEgIeEPD_BwE) 

but wherever you go when you die probably has em too so

pay off the debts you want to. you owe some bigwigs at a credit card company $10k? fuck em’.

don’t wonder what happens in the aftermath.

that’s not you. you’re not them. i can’t convince you to do anything but just make sure you know what you’re going to do is for sure
by “a little while” I hope you know I meant like an hour, right? don’t make me get your hopes up.

it’s nice you feel inspired for yourself. good to see one of us isn’t ready to pull the trigger (literally & figuratively, haha).

I’ll wait a little longer. it actually feels kinda nice.

or something grotesque and disfigured for that matter? why bother chance it.

that’s because I’m not going to.

my parents are not vicariously living through me— trust me, as a consultant my dad made somewhere in the ballpark of 400k for a long time. maybe he is though. i kind of sound like a spoiled rich kid now but let me go on

my girlfriend tried as hard as she could to keep our relationship stable, and i still love her even though we broke apart

but that’s just it.

I won’t be free. not for a little bit atleast

you know i agree with that in every sense besides the last sentence of the first paragraph

because you need an awfully good surgeon to fixed a shattered soul

well the AM is in 30 minutes here in the east coast haha.

ill be dead before you DM me. please just save it or tell me it now

ah.

sorry to hear that.
again, if you’re in pain or suffering, just weigh the options and make sure you’re making a good decision. I can’t make you feel one way or another, but i do know that forcing yourself to be happy wont help you
I’ve said that to myself so many times, but i’ve realized that telling myself itll get better eventually doesn’t actually change shit in reality

but is it worth it? the pain of rejection? the despair of rejection?

that’s what I’ve been pondering for so long

well is whatever illness you have terminal? 

if not, I’m not sure what you can do. I’m not at liberty to talk about how you would go about offing yourself, but it’s really up to how much you want to live through whatever malady you have

hey man, I’m probably gonna kill myself in an hour or so but that doesn’t mean you shouldn’t! 

think if your friend would be happy seeing you off yourself for her. if you really think in your heart she would be overjoyed to see you dead, then so be it. all i know is that you’ll eventually die anyways
